name: system-monitor.owner-headroom-weekly
purpose: Generate one weekly host-headroom report with bounded per-owner CPU, RSS, swap, and VRAM evidence.

report_type.description: This program only accepts weekly report generation.

assumptions: system-monitor is running and its weekly report endpoint is reachable
per-owner process samples are retained for the report window
report completeness and attribution fields describe the data returned by the bounded source query
invariants: the only domain write is creating one weekly report through the system-monitor owner binding
the program makes no inference calls and delegates no work
incomplete or unattributed resource accounting is reported as partial, never as zero
the envelope includes at most the ten highest core-hour owner rows

signals.description: The persisted weekly report identity, bounded owner-resource summary, and up to four runnable follow-up actions from its recommendations.
